source: NASA/JPL OPERA L3 DISP-S1 v1 (Sentinel-1 surface displacement, 30 m), via the ASF DAAC displacement time-series service (no login)
measure: short_wavelength_displacement, radar line-of-sight (LOS), millimetres, relative to the frame's first epoch (frames[].reference); positive = toward the satellite. Not vertical: ascending and descending LOS differ.
sampling: 3x3 lattice per block at +-0.005 deg, both flight directions; each point is one real 30 m pixel (lon/lat = that pixel's centre); every epoch kept, masked epochs flagged
fields: rate_mm_yr|null (OLS slope of unmasked epochs, computed here)
uncertainty: not provided by the time-series service (per-granule quality layers are only in the login-gated .nc files)
licence: CC0 (NASA-led mission data, no use restriction marked; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data)
attribution: OPERA DISP-S1: NASA/JPL/OPERA, ASF DAAC (doi:10.5067/SNWG/OPL3DISPS1-V1); contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data
